description: This file is a shell script designed to test the handling of root commits in merge ranges for 'git svn'. It sets up a Subversion repository with branches and mergeinfo, then initializes and fetches from the repository using git-svn.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a series of SVN and git-svn commands to set up repository, branches, merges, and fetches.
